settings.heading: We built this on a bad thunderstorm night.
settings.lead: Furvago started with one dog, one storm, and the awful feeling of not being able to help.

settings.heading: The night that started it.
settings.body:
There's a specific kind of helplessness in watching your dog come apart during a storm — the shaking, the panting, the way they press into you like you're the only solid thing left. You hold them, and it helps a little, until you have to let go.

We went looking for something that could keep holding them when we couldn't. What we found was the simple, well-understood idea that gentle, steady pressure can calm an anxious body. So we set out to make a vest around it — one that fits properly, goes on easily, and is soft enough to wear through a whole bad night.

Furvago is a small brand with a narrow focus: help dogs feel safe when the world feels like too much. That's the whole mission. No miracle claims — just a thoughtful thing that has helped a lot of dogs settle.
settings.mood_quote: Some nights, they just need to be held a little longer than you can manage.

settings.title: Honest by default
settings.text: We say what the vest can do and what it can't. Gentle pressure helps many dogs — it isn't a cure, and we won't pretend otherwise.

settings.title: One thing, done well
settings.text: We're not trying to sell you a catalog. We're trying to get one product genuinely right.

settings.title: Easy to undo
settings.text: Free shipping and a 30-day return window, because trying something for an anxious dog shouldn't feel risky.

settings.heading: Help them through the next one.
settings.body: The Furvago calming vest, in three colors and five sizes.
